title: GMI theme-graph identity resolution row v1
description: One ROW of data/theme_graph/identity_resolution.parquet, as a JSON object. The V4-D2A bridge between the GMI theme graph's own topology node ids and the Data OS identity spine (data/reference/security_master.parquet + vendor_aliases.parquet, read through lib.dataos.identity). A re-derived SIDE-CAR, never a node column, for the same reason as capability.v1: node rows are keep-first write-once, and a resolution stored there would be a one-way ratchet the master's own coverage growth could never repair. One row per company-kind node per materialized graph generation, including refusals — every company node MUST have a row. See research/prophet_v4/d2/D2A_FROZEN_CONTRACT_2026-08-18.md.

node_id.description: The GMI topology id, verbatim — NEVER rewritten. Must resolve to a company-kind row in nodes.parquet (guard-enforced).

graph_kind.description: The row grain — company-kind nodes only in v1.

market_scope.description: Parsed from the node id (identity.COMPANY_ID_RE). Null only for a node id that failed the grammar entirely (resolution_state=INVALID_SOURCE_ID) and could not even be best-effort split.

graph_identity_epoch.description: From the node id's #<epoch> suffix (epoch 1 implicit). READ-ONLY — epochs come solely from config/theme_graph_identity_breaks.yml. Null only for INVALID_SOURCE_ID.

source_native_symbol.description: The symbol segment of the node id, epoch suffix stripped, upper-cased. Null only for INVALID_SOURCE_ID when even a best-effort split fails. PARSE PROVENANCE ONLY, NEVER A JOIN KEY: this column is not a sanctioned resolution path — the only sanctioned resolution paths are read_identity_resolution() and resolve_graph_node_identity(), never a re-match on this string.

resolution_asof.description: The date used for alias resolution — the generation's belief_time, or the caller's explicit historical asof for a pure re-run.

resolution_state.description: Closed enum, contract §4. NOT_IN_MASTER is a first-class honest refusal state, never a guard failure.

issuer_id.description: ISS:<CC>-<MIC>-<CODE>[.N] of the security's CANONICAL MEMBER, copied from the master's issuer axis ONLY WHEN the master row's own issuer_state is RESOLVED (V4-D2B1 FIX 8 / m3). One issuer may be SHARED by multiple RESOLVED securities that carry identical SEC registrant CIK evidence (e.g. co:us:GOOG and co:us:GOOGL both resolve to ISS:US-XNAS-GOOG, while security_id/listing_key stay distinct per security). Null whenever resolution_state != RESOLVED; ALSO null on a RESOLVED sidecar row whenever the master's own issuer_state for that security is anything OTHER than RESOLVED (NO_ISSUER_EVIDENCE, AMBIGUOUS, EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, DEFERRED_IDENTITY_EXCEPTION) — security_id/listing_key stay non-null regardless (see the guard's amended state<->ids biconditional, F3a: a non-null issuer_id on a RESOLVED sidecar row whose master issuer_state is not RESOLVED is a breach). Historical limitation: CIK evidence is a current-registrant observation only, so this column is canonical for CURRENT issuer identity and is never a historical-lineage claim.

security_id.description: SEC:<CC>-<MIC>-<CODE>[.N] from the master. Null unless resolution_state=RESOLVED.

listing_key.description: Bare <CC>-<MIC>-<CODE>[.N] from the master. Null unless resolution_state=RESOLVED.

join_method.description: How RESOLVED was reached, or 'refused' for every non-RESOLVED state.

master_generated_at.description: Copied verbatim from data/reference/_receipt.json. Null when the master was absent at resolution time.

refusal_reason.description: Text explaining a non-RESOLVED state; for identity exceptions quotes the receipt status+reason. NULL iff resolution_state=RESOLVED.

source_receipts.description: Compact JSON string: the matched master/alias rows, or the conflict/absence evidence. Always present, including for RESOLVED rows.
